VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The acceptance criteria requires that "all 88 tests pass," which is a verifiable, objective requirement. The only evidence provided is a self-report (SELF class provenance), which is an unverified claim by the agent itself. Without independent verification through CI logs, test output, diffs, or other artifacts with higher admissibility (SIGN, WIT, REC, ATT, or PROOF), there is no way to confirm that the tests actually pass or that the fix is correct. Self-reports alone cannot satisfy acceptance criteria that demand objective proof of test passage.
